outcome: Start work: add the proof file in the drawer for minutes, a change, an income schedule and a ledger source, uploaded first and sent with the start (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: **The four drawers draw their fields from data.** As `pm`, minutes shows Project, Meeting, Audience and Proof, and change shows Project, "What the client asked for", Proof, then the help "Emergency changes for an incident use "Emergency change" instead." under the Proof box. As `finance_lead`, "Income detail or schedule inventory" shows Kind (Income detail / Inventory), Reference, Mapping note and Proof, and "Record a ledger source" shows Key, Proof and "Continues (optional)" with its help. The buttons read "Start minutes", "Log change", "Start schedule" and "Record source". `grep -rn "SCH-INC\|QB-JE\|MR-0044\|income_detail_oct\|weekly-sync-notes" frontend/src` returns nothing. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/start-work-proof.test.tsx`; drawers at 1440 and 390.

**Project first.** On minutes and change, before a project is chosen, the Proof box is the disabled box reading "Choose the project first." and no upload can be sent. After choosing Lagoon Health, "Choose a file" is enabled. The schedule and ledger drawers show "Choose a file" at once. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch` (zero upload POSTs before the choice).

**Uploaded only when the backend says so.** Choosing `weekly-sync-notes-17nov.docx` (38,912 bytes) sends one POST `/api/v1/cases/C-0101/evidence` with CSRF and `{kind: "meeting_notes", filename, content_base64, case_revision: 6}` (validates against the generated request schema, no extra keys). The card reads "Uploading…" until the answer, then "Uploaded · 38 KB". With a test double answering 200 without `evidence_id`, the card reads "Not uploaded" and the start sends no proof. — verify: component tests; e2e request log.

**Revision chaining.** On the ledger drawer, two uploads in a row send `case_revision` 2 and then 3. The start sends `case_revision: 4` and `intake.proof` = the second id (or, for a test line with `multiple: true`, both ids in upload order). A second file chosen while the first is uploading is not sent until the first answers. — verify: component test; `tests/start-work-proof-mock.test.ts`.

**Start lands on the work item.** Each drawer filled as in the Boards table sends exactly one E-WORK-START, and a double press still sends one (PMO-0-2). The page lands on `/work/W-1403`, `/work/W-1405`, `/work/W-4401` or `/work/W-4402`. Uploads made no new idempotency key: the start's key is the one made when the drawer opened. — verify: component tests; e2e request log.

**Start is held while proof is unsure.** While an upload is running, and while any card reads "Not uploaded", the Start button is disabled and pressing it sends nothing. Removing the failed file, or a successful Try again, enables it. — verify: component test with a deferred upload response.

**Removing a file.** "×" on an uploaded card removes the card; the next start does not send that id; no request is sent by the removal; the drawer never shows "deleted" or "removed from the record". — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`; `grep -rn "deleted" frontend/src/features/start-work` returns nothing.

**Changing the project clears proof.** On minutes, after uploading to Lagoon Health, choosing another project removes the card and shows "Proof removed: it was added to the other project. Add it again." The next upload goes to the new project's case at that project's revision, and the start sends only proof from the new case. While an upload is running, the Project control is disabled. — verify: component test (persona `ceo`, two projects).

**Upload errors.** With the upload answering 403 or 404, the drawer shows "You can't add proof to this item." in both cases, and nothing on the drawer differs between them. 401 shows the signed-out state. A 422 shows the backend message word for word (the mock's `.exe` sample "EXE files can't be used as proof." and a scenario message). A 409 re-reads E-LINE-OPTIONS (project) or E-LINES (fixed), shows "This item changed. Add the file again.", keeps every typed value, and the next upload sends the re-read revision. A 500 or network failure shows "Couldn't upload. Try again."; Try again re-reads first, then sends one upload. No upload is ever resent without a press. — verify: component tests with fake timers (no second POST after 60 s); `tests/start-work-proof-mock.test.ts`.

**Uncertain upload fixture.** With `psl_mock_start_work=upload_uncertain`, the first upload is stored on the case but answers 500. The card says "Not uploaded", never "Uploaded". Try again re-reads the revision, gets a second id, and the start sends only that id with its revision; the mock accepts it (201). — verify: `e2e/start-work-proof.spec.ts` request log; mock test.

**Start 409 and uncertain start.** A stale 409 on the start keeps every value and every uploaded card, re-reads the revision, and the next press sends the re-read revision with a new key. With `psl_mock_start_work=start_uncertain` the drawer shows "Check again" and "If it started, it will appear in My work.", never "started". Check again sends the identical body and key, and lands on the work item; the mock records one start. — verify: component tests; e2e request log.

**Wrong record.** A start carrying an evidence id from another case, another persona or not issued at all answers 422 "That proof isn't on this record. Add it again.", shown under the Proof box (not as a separate box). As `finance_lead`, an upload to `C-0102` (a project not served to that persona) answers 404, and the drawer shows the 403/404 sentence. — verify: `tests/start-work-proof-mock.test.ts`; component test.

**Access 401/403/404.** Persona `none` gets no lines and no Proof box. An upload or start without the CSRF header answers 403 and the drawer shows its refusal, with no card reading "Uploaded". 401 on E-LINES, an upload or the start shows the signed-out state with `next` set to the current page. 403 and 404 on the start read "You can't start this here." — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`; mock tests.

**Plain text, safe links, no client limits.** A file named `.pdf` and a 422 message containing `bold` render as literal text. The drawer has no `` whose `href` comes from an upload or E-LINES value. The file input has no `accept` attribute, and the start-work diff adds no size or type check (`git diff -U0 frontend/src | grep -nE "PROOF_TYPES|PROOF_MAX_BYTES|accept=|\.size *[<>]"` returns nothing). — verify: component test (`document.querySelector('img')` is null; text present); grep.

**Unknown never 0; nothing from /me.** A fixed line without `case_revision` stays "can't start here yet" and sends nothing. An upload 200 without `case_revision` never makes the start send 0 or blank: it sends the last known revision. No file card ever reads "0 KB". The new start-work code reads neither `/me` nor roles (`grep -rn "useMe\|/api/v1/me\|roles" frontend/src/features/start-work` returns nothing). The same lines file served to `pm`, `ceo` and `finance_lead` draws the same Proof box. — verify: component tests; grep.

**Phone.** At 390 each drawer opens in F-05's bottom sheet with the same fields, words and order as desktop. The file card fits without sideways scroll; long file names wrap. The "×" on the uploaded card, "Choose a file", Try again, the Start button and every segment and select are at least 44 by 44 px (D-92c). Escape and Cancel close the sheet and return focus. — verify: e2e at 390 measuring bounding boxes of each control, the "×" included.

**Fidelity (D-64, D-83).** One design-fidelity run per round over the 8 boards, on a production build at `--width 1440` and `--width 390`, driven as in the Boards table. Every board's element coverage after approved exceptions is 100%. Visual is at least 90, or a board-level waiver citing D-83 in `fidelity-exceptions.json` with visual at least 70 (lower only with a signed one-board floor exception). Every exception has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason`, `approved_by` and maps to a Conflicts number, and none covers a value the data can supply. The UI reviewer's side-by-side reading finds no fixable gap. — verify: the fidelity command per board; `round-<N>/fidelity/scores.txt`.

**Accessibility.** No axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 1440 and 390 on the four drawers in these states: empty, uploading, uploaded, failed, project-changed, the 422 under Proof, and "Check again". The Proof group is labelled by its field label. The file input is named. Upload problems and the project-changed line are announced (`role="status"` or `alert`). "Uploading…" and "Uploaded" are text, not colour. Focus is visible. — verify: `e2e/start-work-proof.spec.ts`.

**Tokens and components only.** The diff adds no `#hex`, `rgb(`, `hsl(` or raw px outside tokens in `start-work.css` (44 px via the control-size token), and no local copy of `ProofField`, `useEvidenceUpload` or any `@/components` export (`Button`, `Callout`, `Segmented`, `Select`, `TextField`). — verify: grep on the diff.

**Mock matches the contract.** In `tests/start-work-proof-mock.test.ts`: the new lines, options and `W-4401`/`W-4402` validate against the generated E-LINES, E-LINE-OPTIONS and E-WORK-ITEM schemas; every upload answer validates against the E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD 200 schema; uploads to C-SETUP-* and to work-item cases still go to their F-11 and F-09 owners (`tests/setup-rules.test.tsx`, `tests/response-mock.test.ts` unchanged and green); `/me` `startable_lines` equals E-LINES keys for every persona; reset restores revision 6 on C-0101, 3 on C-FIN-SCHEDULES and 2 on C-FIN-LEDGER. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/start-work-proof-mock.test.ts tests/start-work-mock.test.ts tests/mock-contract.test.ts`.

**Contract not extended.** `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**`, `frontend/src/components/**`, `frontend/src/shell/**`, `frontend/src/features/response/**` other than the one `useEvidenceUpload.ts` guard, `mock/response.mjs`, `mock/evidence.mjs`, `mock/setup.mjs`, any existing fixture other than `lines.finance_lead.json` and `me.finance_lead.json`, `apps/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**`, `openapi.json` or the protected paths. `server.mjs` changes by the one dispatch branch. Every mock-only field and cookie is listed in build.md. — verify: `git diff --stat`; `git diff frontend/mock/server.mjs frontend/src/features/response`; build.md.

**Existing tests green.** `delivery/checks.sh` passes. The tests listed under Context pass, with only the assertions in Conflicts 13 rewritten (each listed in build.md with the old and new expectation). That includes F-09's `tests/response.test.tsx`, `tests/response-mock.test.ts` and `e2e/response.spec.ts`, F-11's Setup proof test, and, when on the base, F-31's engagement-planning upload tests. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`; `cd frontend && npx vitest run` and the e2e command under Lanes, pasted in build.md.

**build.md evidence.** Commands and results, the 8 scores and waivers, every exception with its Conflicts number, every mock-only field and cookie, the three allowed edits outside the lane, the backend items, and the held list from "What is sent". — verify: file content.

risk.rationale: High. The proof is append-only on a case and is chained into the write that creates work and starts agents. Getting the case or revision wrong (project versus fixed back-office case, or a stale revision after an upload) attaches evidence to the wrong record, and that is hard to undo (INV-REVISION, D-START-INTAKE (4)). SURFACES: ui (4 SCR-04 drawer pairs), api (E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD, E-WORK-START, E-LINES), security (CSRF, case-scoped upload grants, 403 and 404 shown the same, nothing derived from roles), and contract-change (the consumer side of the proposed D-START-INTAKE evidence kind and fixed cases). Payments and payroll are excluded because no money or payroll field is in this slice. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required because the two Finance back-office drawers and proof upload at start are new to the client.

F-09's hook treats that as "use the item's revision". After Try again, `run` still calls `send` with the captured `caseId` and the old revision prop (useEvidenceUpload.ts `revision.current ?? caseRevision`). An upload answering 413 or 415 shows "Couldn't upload. Try again." with a Try again that will fail the same way, and the backend's message is lost. The contract lists only 401/403/404/409/422 for E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD, and the spec has the backend send its limits as 422, so this is within spec. But a proxy or Django body-size limit will answer 413 before the view does. The backend handoff should confirm that size and type limits answer 422 with a message, and that the request-body limit is above the largest allowed file. `frontend/src/api/errors.ts:4-10` maps 413 and 415 to `server`, and `frontend/src/features/response/useEvidenceUpload.ts:104` then makes them retryable.

A 403 or 404 on the start shows "You can't start this here." followed by the backend's own message, word for word. The mock's messages are safe ("Your role does not allow you to start this line." and "We could not find that record."). A faked message holding a case id and a file name was shown in full, and the two messages tell 403 apart from 404. This is F-05 code that this head does not change (`frontend/src/features/start-work/useStartWork.ts:375-376`). The backend should keep 403/404 messages free of record and file names; or the frontend could show only the lead sentence in a later slice.

Open non-blocking items to carry. They stay OPEN in feature.json and none is an acceptance gate. UX-1-2 (no reason line beside a held Start), UX-1-3 (desktop "×" is 24 px, and the spec asks for 44 px on phones only), UX-1-4 (file input named through the group; QA axe was clean at both widths, so this is likely closable), UI-1-1 (signatures, human item 2 and 3), UI-1-3 (fallback fonts on two boards), QA-2-1 (413/415 message lost; backend must confirm limits answer 422), QA-2-2 (403/404 on the start show the backend message; backend should keep record and file names out of it).
